question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
WITH team_max_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        home_team_api_id as team_id,
        MAX(home_team_goal) as max_goals
    FROM Match
    WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id
    UNION
    SELECT 
        away_team_api_id as team_id,
        MAX(away_team_goal) as max_goals
    FROM Match
    WHERE away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY away_team_api_id
),
team_highest AS (
    SELECT team_id, MAX(max_goals) as highest_season_goals
    FROM team_max_goals
    GROUP BY team_id
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_teams,
    MEDIAN(highest_season_goals) as median_value
FROM team_highest
